verdict.rationale: Motion has bookable calendars, so a booking-webhooks story is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents only a REST API for tasks and projects and a Zapier integration. Nothing shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for bookings being created, rescheduled, or canceled, and Zapier connectivity is an adjacent integration, not first-party webhooks.

support.subject: As a developer, webhooks notify my systems in real time when bookings are created, rescheduled, or canceled
